title: restic.status.v1
description: Where backups stand on a host: the latest restic.commit.v1 of every stream (backing up and transferring alike), the latest restic.forget.v1 of every stream, and whether the repository passwords are primed.  It is a roll-up of the other restic events plus a look at the password cache, emitted after every backup, transfer and priming and by 'backup status', so one state file answers 'are my backups healthy?'.  Subject: the backup job, 'backup'.

outcome.description: The newest event of one stream, abridged: restic.commit.v1 or restic.forget.v1 fields of the same names.

result.description: The worst result among commits and forgets: fail if any failed, else partial if any was partial, else ok; unknown if there are none.  Says nothing about the password, see prime.

prime.description: The password cache, per password ('local', 'remote'), as seen when the event was made.

primed.description: Whether a valid cached password exists.

ttl_remaining.description: Seconds left; rounded to the cache's own resolution when the exact time is unknown.

expires.description: RFC 3339 expiry, present only when known exactly.

error.description: Why the cache could not be examined.
